ideas.title: Minnesota's Efforts to Tackle Fraud: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate Minnesota's approach to addressing fraud, including the Feeding Our Future case and potential state takeover of Medicaid funds.
questions: What are the root causes of fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's efforts to tackle fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it sheds light on the state's efforts to address fraud and protect vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: The Implications of the Federal Reserve Investigation
ideas.description: This story would explore the implications of the court ruling blocking the DOJ's probe into Jerome Powell and the Federal Reserve.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the court's decision?
How might this impact future investigations into the Federal Reserve?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises questions about oversight and accountability within the Federal Reserve.
